$schema: Message package definitions for the CNI DERMS device data ingestion pipeline
description: Defines all message kinds accepted by POST /api/v1/DeviceData/Ingest and related endpoints. Each RTU sends messages with a 'kind' discriminator that routes data to the correct storage bucket.

ingest.description: Ingest a single telemetry message from an RTU/edge device.

request.kind: string — Message kind discriminator (required, see 'kinds' below)
request.payload: string — JSON payload as a string (required)
request.deviceLocalTime: string? — ISO 8601 timestamp from the device (optional, defaults to UTC now)

ingestBatch.description: Ingest a batch of telemetry messages.

request.messages: array of ingest request objects (same schema as single ingest)

ingestAlarm.description: Ingest alarm data from an RTU. Uses snapshot comparison — any active alarm in the DB not present in the message is auto-recovered.

request.rtuSn: string — RTU serial number that reported the alarm (required)
request.deviceName: string — Name of the device the alarm belongs to (required, matched under the RTU)

alarms.code: string — Alarm type code (e.g., 'CellOverVoltage', 'PcsOverTemp'). Maps to DeviceAlarmType.Code. Auto-created if not found.
alarms.severity: string? — critical | high | medium | low (optional, used when auto-creating alarm type)
alarms.active: boolean — true = fault active, false = fault cleared
alarms.message: string? — Human-readable alarm description (optional, stored in Details JSON)
alarms.value: number? — Current measured value that triggered the alarm (optional)
alarms.raisedAt: string? — ISO 8601 timestamp when the alarm was originally raised (optional, defaults to deviceLocalTime or UTC now)

request.deviceLocalTime: string? — ISO 8601 timestamp (optional, defaults to UTC now)

response.created: int — Number of new alarms created

SmartMeter.description: Grid meter and smart meter telemetry

ContainerBatteryState.description: Overall battery container state (SoC, SoH, voltage, current, power, temps)

ContainerBatteryCellMapState.description: Per-cell voltage/temperature mapping for Tesla Megapack

ContainerBatteryFaultState.description: Legacy: Battery fault flags embedded in telemetry (deprecated — use Ingest/Alarm instead)
ContainerBatteryFaultState.deprecatedReason: Alarm data should be sent via POST /api/v1/DeviceData/Ingest/Alarm

PcsState.description: Power conversion system state (AC/DC measurements, operating mode)

Device.Alarm.description: Dedicated alarm messages sent via POST /api/v1/DeviceData/Ingest/Alarm. Not routed through the telemetry pipeline — uses its own dedicated handler.
Device.Alarm.note: This kind is NOT processed by DeviceDataCategorizer. It has its own endpoint and handler.
